# Vendored flybrain package

This directory contains the small `flybrain` runtime package used by the optional FLYWORLD MaleCNS bridge. It is vendored so the project dependency is visible and reproducible without copying the unrelated upstream website, experiments or media.

Upstream: <https://github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai>

License: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The MaleCNS data files are downloaded separately and retain their own CC BY 4.0 attribution.
